# AVI Core

> Universal offline media processing engine & context-menu converter for Windows. Built for lightning-fast, 100% offline conversions without file upload limits, ads, or telemetry.

**Key Highlights & Features**
* 100% Offline & Private: Zero network requests, zero file uploads, no tracking. All processing occurs locally.
* Native Windows Context Menu: Right-click single or multiple files in Windows File Explorer to convert instantly.
* Automatic Safety Backups: Automatically vaults original files into a timestamped/dedicated backup folder before processing to prevent accidental overwrite.
* High-Performance Hardware Execution: Direct local hardware pipeline via bundled, optimized FFmpeg binaries with `--fast` stream copy mode.
* Dual Interface: Native Windows Shell Context Menu + full-featured developer CLI (`avicore`).
* Free & Open Source: Licensed under MIT with no paywalls or watermarks.

**Supported Formats**
* Video: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WEBM, FLV, WMV, TS, M4V
* Audio: MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, OPUS, WMA
* Image: PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, ICO

**CLI Command Reference**
* `avicore video convert [input] [format]`: Convert video format (e.g. `avicore video convert movie.mkv mp4`). Supports `--fast` (stream copy) and `--force` (overwrite).
* `avicore video mute [input]`: Remove audio stream while keeping video intact.
* `avicore audio extract [input] [format]`: Extract audio track from video (e.g. `avicore audio extract clip.mp4 mp3`).
* `avicore audio convert [input] [format]`: Convert audio between formats.
* `avicore image convert [input] [format]`: Convert single or wildcard image batches (e.g. `avicore image convert "*.png" webp`).
* `avicore image compress [input] --quality [1-100]`: Compress image files.
* `avicore menu install` / `avicore menu remove`: Register or remove the Windows File Explorer context menu.

**System Requirements & Installation**
* OS: Windows 10 (64-bit), Windows 11, or Linux (CLI mode).
* Standalone: No separate Python or FFmpeg installation required when using the Windows installer package.
